title: SubRip (.srt) — diarized by a "Name:" prefix
source_format: SRT, exported from a captioning tool. Speakers come from the "Host:" / "Guest:" prefix on each cue.

title: WebVTT (.vtt) — diarized by <v> voice tags
source_format: WebVTT. Speakers come from the <v Name> voice tags, the format's own way of marking who is talking.

title: Whisper JSON — undiarized, with word timings
source_format: openai-whisper with --output_format json --word_timestamps True. No speaker labels: Whisper alone does not diarize, so every turn is unassigned and you pick the speaker.

title: YouTube json3 — auto-captions
source_format: yt-dlp --write-auto-subs --sub-format json3. Auto-captions have per-word timings but no punctuation and no speakers.

title: Praat TextGrid — one tier per speaker
source_format: A Praat TextGrid from a fieldwork session. Each tier is a participant, so the tier name becomes the speaker and the silences between intervals are skipped.

title: Deepgram JSON — diarized cloud ASR
source_format: A Deepgram response with diarize=true and utterances=true. Speaker indices become speaker_0 / speaker_1.
